rows.author: C139
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING COCONUT TREES FROM REAL PROPERTY TAXATION
rows.abstract: Rationale: Under the Local Government Code (RA 7160),  every full-grown tree is subject to TAX as an improvement over and above the tax imposed on the land.  Three million hectares of our agricultural lands are planted with coconut rtrees.  The imposition of tax HINDERS and DISCOURAGES farmers and landowners from planting fruit-bearing trees like the coconut.  Many coconut trees are 65 years old and are therefore no longer productive. Thus, this bill.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2000-04-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING A MONTHLY PENSION OF ONE THOUSAND PESOS TO SENIOR CITIZENS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTY-TWO, ENTITLED `AN ACT TO MAXIMIZE CONTRIBUTION OF SENIOR CITIZENS TO NATION BUILDING, GRANT BENEFITS AND SPECIAL PRIVILEGES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES'
rows.abstract: Rationale: After having served the country in the most productive years of their lives, it is unfortunate that senior citizens  who have retired from private or public service and are neither gainfully employed not have any other source of income other than their retirement benefits, are suffering. Factors such as the sharp devaluation of the peso, the rise in the prices of fuel, transportation, basic goods, medicines, services, etc., aggravate the situation, and finding ways to supplement their income is hardly possible for the senior citizens who are old and weak to find a new job.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF RESPIRATORY THERAPY AND CREATING THE BOARD OF EXAMINERS FOR RESPIRATORY THERAPISTS, PROVIDING FOR ITS STRUCTURE AND ORGANIZATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Philippine Respiratory Act of 2000". This bill substantiates the policy of the State to recognize the vital role of respiratory therapy, as a profession, and to assume responsibility for its protection and improvement by instituting measures that will result in relevant education, better carer prospects and a dignified and ethical practice of the profession. Respiratory Therapy is an allied health specially employed with medical direction in the treatment, management, control, diagnostic evaluation and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities in the cardiopulmonary system.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042 ENTITLED `AN ACT TO INSTITUTE THE POLICIES OF OVERSEAS EMPLOYMENT AND ESTABLISH A HIGHER STANDARD OF PROTECTION AND PROMOTION OF THE WELFARE OF MIGRANT WORKERS, THEIR FAMILIES AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS IN DISTRESS,AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Omnibus Amendments to RA 8142, the Migrant Worker and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995". Rationale: The implementation of RA 8042 for the past five years saw the urgent need for the government to review and assess the long-term implications of certain provisions of the law. In fact, the law is now the subject of several amendatory bills pending in this August Chamber. Moreover, the series of consultations with the various sectors concerned has revealed other needed amendments that are not covered by these bills. This bill seeks to consolidate the concerns of such pending bills.
